notes: Live Shopify storefront, direct fetch (no proxy, no blocking) exactly as the prior Home-Decor pass reported. TREE: taken from the site's own desktop mega-menu FURNITURE column, the mobile menu, and the sub-nav tab bar rendered on /collections/furniture itself - all three agree on exactly four children: Seating (chairs-sofas), Ottomans & Footstools, Headboards & Beds (beds-headboards), Garden Furniture. 'All Furniture' (/collections/furniture) is the parent and is dropped per the no-'All' / no-parent-as-leaf rules. 'Bespoke' and 'Free Interior Design Services' in the same nav column are service pages, not listings. Cross-checked against the full /collections.json enumeration (153 collections): there is NO tables, desks, wardrobes, cabinets, bookcases, sideboards, storage-furniture or dining-furniture collection anywhere on this store - HoH is a wallpaper/fabric/paint house with a small upholstery-led furniture range. QTY: the rendered collection page embeds Liquid collection.products_count for the exact market being served; that number was read off each of the four leaf pages and independently confirmed by counting unique product ids in /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 with page=2 verified empty (61/16/33/3/7 - both sources identical on every leaf). The GLOBAL /collections.json products_count is inflated here exactly as flagged project-wide (furniture 101 vs 61, Seating 40 vs 16, Ottomans 39 vs 33) and was NOT used. SANITY CHECKS: every leaf re-read a second time - identical numbers, no session drift; the numbers discriminate (mirrors returns 3, not a site-wide constant); a bogus slug returns a real 404 so no silent parent-listing substitution; the UK bare-path URLs (/collections/<h>) return the same counts as /en-intl, and /en-intl is what the site's own <link rel=canonical> and mega-menu use, so /en-intl is recorded (same convention as the prior pass). COVERAGE NOTE: the four children cover 52 of the parent's 61 products; 9 products sit in the Furniture collection with no child collection of their own (CASTLE Bookcase, 2x CASTLE Wardrobe, 3x BRUNEL console/side/lamp tables, WILD CARD Toad Stool, 2x De Beauvoir sofas). The site publishes no listing page for them, and recording the parent as a leaf alongside its children is forbidden, so they are not separately emitted. Conversely the 7 Garden Furniture parasols are NOT members of the Furniture collection - it is a sibling branch. The only on-page facets are material (Cotton Linen/Hemp/Jacquard/Velvet) and colour filter hashes - excluded as filter pages. EXCLUDED as out of scope: Carpets/Rugs/Runners/Doormats/Axminster (same nav column, textiles), Bedding, Headboards & Bedding (mixed bedding collection, superseded by the nav's beds-headboards), Cushions, Curtains, Blinds, Textiles, all Fabric/Wallpaper/Paint/Tiles branches, Lighting, Mirrors, Vases, Decorations & Ornaments, Wonder Garden, and every named print/collab/colour 'Edit' bundle.
